blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 23:16:46 UTC. On Celo block 73552648, GBPm proxy 0xccf663b1ff11028f0b19058d0f7b674004a40746 resolves via EIP-1967 to verified StableTokenV3 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318 and owner() is the Mento 4-of-6 Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458. The verified implementation has owner-gated setBurner/setOperator; its live TroveManager 0xb38aEf2bF4e34B997330D626EBCd7629De3885C9 and StabilityPool 0x06346c0fAB682dBde9f245D2D84677592E8aaa15 both return isBurner=true, and StabilityPool isOperator=true. Therefore those contracts can call burn(address,uint256) or sendToPool(sender,...) against an arbitrary GBPm holder without allowance: direct individual-holder intervention is Yes. The Monad proxy 0x39bb4e0a204412bb98e821d25e7d955e69d40fd1 at block 91758657 resolves to StableTokenSpoke 0x6a8ff60a89f3f359fa16f45076d6dd1712b5e62e, whose source exposes only self-burn burn(uint256); its current isBurner reads for the Celo CDP contracts are false. The Celo path controls the asset-level verdict. USDm/cusd-celo reserve exposure remains an inherited upstream failure domain (asset:cusd-celo), separate from the direct burner/operator reach.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them. The GBPm Celo CDP branch (Liquity v2 fork) has been reviewed on-chain: USDm-collateralized troves liquidate below a 110% MCR with a 135% system CCR and a 110% shutdown SCR.

branchApplicability.rationale: GBPm's material issuance path is the Celo USDm-collateralized CDP (Liquity v2 fork); its oracle and liquidation parameters were confirmed on-chain via the SystemParamsProxyGBPm contract. Monad's GBPm deployment is a separate issuer-native mirrored mint (already reviewed under mintAuthority/bridgeRouteRisk) with no independent collateral-liquidation branch of its own, so only the Celo CDP branch is inventoried here.

branches.label: GBPm/USDm CDP (Liquity v2 fork, Celo)
branches.summary: GBPm's Celo CDP branch prices GBP/USD via Mento's FXPriceFeed -> OracleAdapter -> SortedOracles path and liquidates USDm-collateralized troves below a 110% MCR, with a 135% system CCR and a 110% SCR shutdown threshold enforced by a dedicated SystemParams contract.

feeds.path: SortedOracles GBP/USD rate feed -> Mento OracleAdapter.getFXRateIfValid -> GBPm FXPriceFeed -> TroveManager collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: GBPm's FXPriceFeed (0xBBB144A67f4403112b4C895Cc85d5EE4F90013DE) reads oracleAdapter.getFXRateIfValid(rateFeedID) during normal operation; per Mento's CDP documentation it falls back to a cached lastValidPrice during emergency shutdown or CDP-market-closed windows (BreakerBox-gated weekends/holidays), with no alternate third-party oracle provider.

collateralParameters.note: On-chain SystemParamsProxyGBPm (0x70536e44d1D9238BA8E35Ffe63Bb388a63F0DE51) returned MCR=1.1e18 (110%), CCR=1.35e18 (135% critical/system ratio), and SCR=1.1e18 (110% shutdown ratio) at Celo block 72722909.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Troves below the 110% MCR are liquidated: the StabilityPoolGBPm offsets debt first (5% liquidation penalty to SP depositors, per SystemParams.LIQUIDATION_PENALTY_SP), with any shortfall redistributed to remaining troves at a 10% penalty (LIQUIDATION_PENALTY_REDISTRIBUTION). TroveManager reported 4 open trove IDs and shutdownTime=0 (not shut down) at Celo block 72722909.
branches.backstop: StabilityPoolGBPm (0x06346c0fAB682dBde9f245D2D84677592E8aaa15) holds GBPm deposits; depositors absorb liquidated debt and receive the corresponding USDm collateral at the 5% Stability Pool penalty rate before any redistribution to remaining troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: If the branch's total collateral ratio falls below the 110% SCR, redemptions are blocked (TroveManager requires TCR >= SCR and shutdownTime == 0 to permit redemption) and the branch can enter shutdown, during which FXPriceFeed serves its cached lastValidPrice instead of a live oracle read. Redistribution among remaining troves is the bad-debt backstop for any shortfall the Stability Pool cannot absorb.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GBPm is part of Mento's local stablecoin system and is documented as available directly on supported chains. No holder-facing bridge or lockbox route was resolved for GBPm, so Pharos treats route risk as native issuance on the relevant chain deployments.
